beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This qualification keeps the constructive direction tied to a problem, rather than a new identity.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with the preface and its distinction between entrepreneurial value and the founder mythology.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Follow the race and attention chapters before judging the proposed alternative.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The collaboration chapter supplies the working obligations behind the language of shared institutions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The final doctrine then asks where a useful commons could justify its governance costs.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This is a book for builders willing to examine the institutions surrounding their own effort.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its depth lies in connecting individual pressure with the reusable structures that might change it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it to decide what should be built once, so others can stop rebuilding it alone.
